Dear Information and Privacy Coordinator:

Under the Freedom of Information Act, 5 U.S.C. § 552, I request copies of the records described below.

Subject identification
• Full name: James C. Porrazzo
• Variant spellings of surname: Porrazo; Porazzo. Please search each with the first name James, James C., or J. C.
• Date of birth: July 18, 1971
• Citizenship: United States
• Date of death: April 28, 2025
• Place of death: Novi Sad, Serbia
• Associated organizations and publications: American Front; New Resistance and its publication Open Revolt!; Archeofuturist Front; Global Revolutionary Alliance; Center for Syncretic Studies; Total War News; Atlantis Foundation; Rural People’s Party; New Bihar Mandir; Swords of Songun

Records requested
1.  All records concerning James Porrazzo in any CIA directorate, office, or overseas station.
2.  All records concerning his residence, travel, or activities outside the United States, including in Serbia.
3.  All records concerning contacts or communications between Mr. Porrazzo and Russian nationals or organizations, including Alexander Dugin, the Eurasian Movement, the Russian Defense League, and organizations associated with them.
4.  All records concerning contacts or communications between Mr. Porrazzo and the government of North Korea or persons acting on its behalf, including the Pyongyang Mission of the Anti-Imperialist National Democratic Front of South Korea and the Committee for Cultural and Foreign Relations.
5.  All records that refer to Mr. Porrazzo in connection with the organizations and publications listed above.

The date range is January 1, 1990 through the date of your search. If the CIA issues a response that it can neither confirm nor deny the existence of records, please state which of the numbered categories it applies to and the specific exemptions and statutes relied on.

Proof of death
Mr. Porrazzo died on April 28, 2025 in Novi Sad, Serbia. This is public information and has been widely reported, e.g.: https://arktos.com/2025/04/30/memento-mori-in-memoriam-james-porrazzo; https://www.voxnr.fr/en-memoire-de-james-porazzon; https://news-pravda.com/world/2025/04/29/1281705.html

Public interest in disclosure
Mr. Porrazzo was a national leader of the American Front and later a promoter in the United States of the Russian “Fourth Political Theory” associated with Alexander Dugin, and he later lived in Serbia and edited the media outlet Total War News. Any records would inform the public about the intersection of domestic extremist networks and foreign governments and movements. His death diminishes his privacy interest.

Fees and news media status
I am an independent journalist. I request treatment as a representative of the news media and a waiver of fees because disclosure is in the public interest and I intend to publish my findings. If a waiver is denied, I commit to pay fees of up to $100 and ask you to contact me before fees exceed that amount.

Format
Please send records electronically (PDF), release all reasonably segregable portions of any record you withhold, and identify each exemption you apply. Please acknowledge receipt and give me a tracking number.

Thank you for your assistance.
Sincerely,
Oscar Cozza

Dear FOIA Officer:
Under the Freedom of Information Act, 5 U.S.C. § 552, I request copies of the records described below.

Subject identification
• Full name: James C. Porrazzo
• Variant spellings of surname: Porrazo; Porazzo. Please search each with the first name James, James C., or J. C.
• Date of birth: July 18, 1971
• Citizenship: United States
• Date of death: April 28, 2025
• Place of death: Novi Sad, Serbia
• Associated organizations and publications: American Front; New Resistance and its publication Open Revolt!; Archeofuturist Front; Global Revolutionary Alliance; Center for Syncretic Studies; Total War News; Atlantis Foundation; Rural People’s Party; New Bihar Mandir; Swords of Songun
• Places associated with him: New York; Boston, Massachusetts; Royalston, Massachusetts; Springfield, Missouri; Arkansas; South Carolina; Serbia

Records requested
1.  All records about James Porrazzo in the FBI's Central Records System, including main files and cross-references, at FBI Headquarters, field offices, and Legal Attaché offices.
2.  All records concerning his membership in, leadership of, or activities on behalf of the organizations and publications listed above.
3.  All records that name or refer to him in the FBI's investigation of American Front members in Florida, including St. Cloud, that led to arrests in May 2012, including any records of reported threats against him and of any threats attributed to him against rivals for leadership of the group.
4.  All records concerning his residence, travel, or activities in Serbia.
5.  All records concerning his involvement with the Rural People’s Party, the New Bihar Mandir temple in Lexington County, South Carolina, and the Swords of Songun website.
6.  All records concerning contacts or communications between Mr. Porrazzo and the government of North Korea or persons acting on its behalf, and his reported involvement with U.S. groups that support North Korea.

Please search under all the name variants and the date of birth above. The date range is January 1, 1990 through the date of your search, so that records created after his death are included.

Proof of death
Mr. Porrazzo died on April 28, 2025 in Novi Sad, Serbia. This has been widely reported, e.g.: https://arktos.com/2025/04/30/memento-mori-in-memoriam-james-porrazzo; https://www.voxnr.fr/en-memoire-de-james-porazzon; https://news-pravda.com/world/2025/04/29/1281705.html

Public interest in disclosure
If any privacy interest is found to remain, I ask that it be weighed against the public interest in disclosure. Mr. Porrazzo was a national leader of the American Front, a racist skinhead organization whose members were prosecuted in 2012, and later a promoter in the United States of the Russian “Fourth Political Theory” associated with Alexander Dugin. His public role is documented in the Southern Poverty Law Center's Intelligence Report (https://www.splcenter.org/resources/reports/neo-nazi-leader-james-porrazzo-mixes-racism-leftist-ideology/). The records would show how the FBI monitored domestic extremist networks with ties to foreign governments and movements. Those matters are of significant public interest, and his death diminishes his privacy interest.

Fees and news media status
I am an independent journalist. I request treatment as a representative of the news media and a waiver of fees because disclosure is in the public interest and I intend to publish my findings. If a waiver is denied, I agree to pay up to $100 and ask you to contact me before fees exceed that amount.

Format
Please send records electronically (PDF) by email or through the portal, with rolling releases if you can. Release all reasonably segregable portions of any record you withhold, and identify each exemption you apply. Please acknowledge receipt and give me a tracking number.
Thank you for your assistance.

Sincerely,
Oscar Cozza
